a. Becomes public through no fault of the Contractor
b. Was known to the Contractor before the Company's disclosure

This Agreement is made on [Date] between [Company Name] ("Company"), located at [Company Address], and [Contractor/Supplier Name] ("Contractor/Supplier"), located at [Contractor/Supplier Address].

1. PURPOSE
To protect exclusive insights and confidential information during discussions for technological partnerships and potential business collaborations.

2. DEFINITION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
Confidential information includes, but is not limited to:
a. Internal software blueprints and designs
b. Intellectual property awaiting patents
c. Research results and devices produced by the Company
d. Business strategies and financial data
e. Customer information
f. Any other information deemed proprietary or not generally known to the public

3. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS
The Contractor/Supplier agrees to:
a. Uphold confidentiality and ensure data integrity
b. Utilize confidential information strictly for collaborative ventures
c. Not disclose, use, reproduce, or distribute confidential information unless necessary for their obligations to the Company
d. Refrain from sharing this information, barring any legal requirements

4. EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIALITY
Confidentiality obligations do not apply to information that:
a. Becomes public through no fault of the Contractor/Supplier
b. Was already known by the Contractor/Supplier before the Company's disclosure

5. NON-COMPETITION
For 12 months post-relationship, the Contractor/Supplier agrees not to:
a. Provide similar services to any entity competing with the Company within a 50-mile radius of any Company location
b. Compete with the Company or assist others in doing so

6. NON-SOLICITATION
For 12 months post-relationship, the Contractor/Supplier agrees not to:
a. Solicit or induce any entity or individual connected to the Company to cease or reduce their relationship with the Company
b. Solicit the Company's clients or customers for the benefit of a competitor

7. RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION AND PROPERTY
Upon relationship termination or the Company's request, the Contractor/Supplier will:
a. Immediately return all Company property
b. Return or destroy all copies of Confidential Information

8. PENALTIES AND REMEDIES
a. For each breach of this Agreement, the Contractor/Supplier shall pay the Company a penalty of $295,000
b. The Company may seek specific performance and injunctive relief, in addition to other remedies

9. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by the laws of [State/Country].

10. DURATION
This Agreement is valid for [X years], unless the Company provides written termination.

11. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement supersedes all previous agreements and understandings on the subject and can only be altered by a written document approved by both parties.

12. BINDING EFFECT
This Agreement is legally enforceable for signatories and their successors.

By signing below, both parties acknowledge understanding and voluntarily accepting the Agreement.

This Agreement is made on [Date] between [Company Name] ("Company"), located at [Company Address], and [Contractor/Supplier Name] ("Contractor/Supplier"), located at [Contractor/Supplier Address].

1. PURPOSE
To protect exclusive insights and confidential information during discussions for technological partnerships and potential business collaborations.

2. DEFINITION OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
Confidential information includes, but is not limited to:
a. Internal software blueprints and designs
b. Intellectual property awaiting patents
c. Research results and devices produced by the Company
d. Business strategies and financial data
e. Customer information
f. Any other information deemed proprietary or not generally known to the public

3. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS
The Contractor/Supplier agrees to:
a. Uphold confidentiality and ensure data integrity
b. Utilize confidential information strictly for collaborative ventures
c. Not disclose, use, reproduce, or distribute confidential information unless necessary for their obligations to the Company
d. Refrain from sharing this information, barring any legal requirements

4. EXCEPTIONS TO CONFIDENTIALITY
Confidentiality obligations do not apply to information that:
a. Becomes public through no fault of the Contractor/Supplier
b. Was already known by the Contractor/Supplier before the Company's disclosure

5. NON-COMPETITION
For 12 months post-relationship, the Contractor/Supplier agrees not to:
a. Provide similar services to any entity competing with the Company within a 50-mile radius of any Company location
b. Compete with the Company or assist others in doing so

6. NON-SOLICITATION
For 12 months post-relationship, the Contractor/Supplier agrees not to:
a. Solicit or induce any entity or individual connected to the Company to cease or reduce their relationship with the Company
b. Solicit the Company's clients or customers for the benefit of a competitor

7. RETURN OF CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION AND PROPERTY
Upon relationship termination or the Company's request, the Contractor/Supplier will:
a. Immediately return all Company property
b. Return or destroy all copies of Confidential Information

8. PENALTIES AND REMEDIES
a. For each breach of this Agreement, the Contractor/Supplier shall pay the Company a penalty of $295,000
b. The Company may seek specific performance and injunctive relief, in addition to other legal remedies

9. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by the laws of [State/Country].

10. DURATION
This Agreement is valid for [X years], unless the Company provides written termination.

11. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement supersedes all previous agreements and understandings on the subject and can only be altered by a written document approved by both parties.

12. ASSIGNMENT
This Agreement is binding on the parties' successors and assignees. Neither party may assign its rights or obligations without the other party's written consent.

13. SEVERABILITY
If any provision of this Agreement is found to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.
